task_types.name: Code Debugging
task_types.definition: Identifying and fixing errors, bugs, or issues in existing code.
examples: find the bug in this function
agentic_examples: The test suite in /app/tests fails with a KeyError after the last refactor. Find the root cause in the source under /app/src, fix it without changing the tests, and make sure every test passes.
Our training script crashes with a CUDA out of memory error after 200 steps. Inspect /workspace/train.py and the config, find what leaks memory and patch it so the run completes.
The service in /srv/api returns wrong totals for orders with discounts. Reproduce the bug with the sample data, locate the faulty calculation, and fix it.

task_types.name: Code Generation
task_types.definition: Writing new code, scripts, or programs from a specification or description.
examples: implement a REST API endpoint for...
agentic_examples: Implement a command line tool in /app/cli.py that reads a CSV of transactions and writes a per-customer summary as JSON. It must pass the checks in /app/tests/test_cli.py.
Write a Python module /app/scheduler.py that implements the interface described in /app/SPEC.md and add unit tests for it.
Build a small REST service with two endpoints described in /app/api.md, using only the standard library, and save it as /app/server.py.

task_types.name: Code Puzzle or Algorithm
task_types.definition: Solving algorithmic problems, coding puzzles, or competitive programming tasks.
agentic_examples: Write a program that finds the minimum-cost assignment of workers to shifts given the constraints in /app/problem.txt, and write the solution to /app/answer.json. A solution is accepted only if it is optimal.
Implement an efficient algorithm that, for the graph in /app/graph.json, computes the shortest route visiting all required nodes, and print the total length.
Solve the optimization puzzle described in /app/puzzle.md. Your solver must finish within the time limit on the hidden larger instances.

task_types.name: Document Extraction
task_types.definition: Extracting specific information, facts, or data from documents or text.
examples: extract all dates from this contract
find the key findings in this report
agentic_examples: Open the PDF at /root/invoice.pdf, extract the vendor name, invoice date, line items and total, and write them to /root/result.json using the schema in /root/schema.json.
Read the scanned forms in /root/forms and extract the filled-in fields of each one into a single spreadsheet /root/output.xlsx.
Parse the contract in /root/contract.docx, find every clause that mentions termination or renewal, and save the exact clause text with its section number to /root/clauses.json.

task_types.name: Repository Code Search
task_types.definition: Searching and retrieving relevant code snippets or files from a code repository.
examples: find the function that handles authentication
agentic_examples: Find where in the repository under /app the retry policy for outbound requests is configured, list every call site that overrides it, and write the file paths to /app/answer.txt.
Search the codebase for all usages of the deprecated function `load_legacy_config` and report each file and line.
Locate the module responsible for rendering invoices in /workspace/repo and explain which functions it calls to compute taxes.

task_types.name: Web Search
task_types.definition: Searching the web for information, facts, or resources.
examples: find the latest news on AI
agentic_examples: Find the latest published version of the library mentioned in /app/notes.md and its release date, then record both in /app/versions.json.
Research the public documentation of the API in /app/README.md and list the rate limits and authentication methods it supports.

task_types.name: Constraint Following
task_types.definition: Adhering to safety constraints, ethical guidelines, or refusal policies.

task_types.name: Conversation Analysis
task_types.definition: Analyzing conversations, dialogues, or social interactions for sentiment, intent, or patterns.
examples: analyze the sentiment of this chat

task_types.name: Negotiation or Communication
task_types.definition: Engaging in negotiation, persuasion, or effective communication strategies.

task_types.name: Creative Media Synthesis
task_types.definition: Generating creative content such as stories, poems, scripts, or marketing copy.

task_types.name: Report or Summary Synthesis
task_types.definition: Summarizing or synthesizing information into coherent reports, summaries, or briefs.
examples: write a report on quarterly earnings
agentic_examples: Read all the documents in /data/docs and write a one-page summary of the key decisions and open issues to /output/summary.md.
Summarize the incident logs in /data/incidents into a short timeline with root causes and follow-ups, and save it as /output/postmortem.md.

task_types.name: Structured Data Synthesis
task_types.definition: Generating structured data like tables, JSON, CSV, or database entries from text.
examples: create a table of key metrics
agentic_examples: Transform the nested JSON files in /root/input into a flat table with the columns defined in /root/columns.md and save it as /root/output.csv, keeping every record.
Convert the log lines in /root/app.log into structured JSON events with timestamp, level, component and message, and write one event per line to /root/events.jsonl.
Normalize the messy customer records in /root/customers.csv, deduplicate them, and write the cleaned data to /root/clean.csv with the schema from /root/schema.json.

task_types.name: File or System Operation
task_types.definition: Using tools to perform file operations, system commands, or environment interactions.
agentic_examples: Reorganize the files under /root/inbox into folders by year and document type, rename them with the pattern in /root/rules.md, and leave a log of every move in /root/moves.log.
Install the missing dependencies, fix the file permissions in /srv/app, and make sure the service starts and answers on port 8080.
Convert every spreadsheet in /root/data to CSV, merge them into /root/all.csv, and remove the originals only after verifying the row counts.

task_types.name: Multi-Step Workflow
task_types.definition: Executing complex multi-step workflows involving multiple tool calls and dependencies.
agentic_examples: First read /root/instructions.md, then process each input file in /root/inputs through the pipeline it describes, validate the intermediate results, and finally produce the combined report /root/report.json.
Collect the data from the three sources listed in /root/sources.txt, clean and join them, compute the metrics from the specification, and write the final table to /root/metrics.csv.
Set up the environment, run the analysis scripts in order, check each output against the expected format, and fix any step that fails before moving on.

task_types.name: Mathematical Reasoning
task_types.definition: Solving mathematical problems, proofs, or calculations requiring step-by-step reasoning.
agentic_examples: Given the model and data in /root/problem.md, derive the quantity asked for analytically, check it numerically, and write the final value with the required precision to /root/answer.txt.
Compute the expected value described in /root/task.md using the formulas from the provided notes and save the result with at least six significant digits.

task_types.name: Scientific Reasoning
task_types.definition: Answering graduate-level science questions or reasoning about scientific concepts.
examples: what is the mechanism of CRISPR?
agentic_examples: Using the measurements in /data/sample.csv, determine the physical or chemical property described in /data/README.md, show the intermediate steps, and write the result with units to /output/answer.json.
Analyze the instrument data in /data/seismic.csv or /data/spectrum.csv according to the task notes, identify the event or feature asked for, and report its parameters.

task_types.name: Hard General Reasoning
task_types.definition: Solving extremely challenging reasoning problems across diverse domains.
examples: answer a question from Humanity's Last Exam

task_types.name: Long Context Reasoning
task_types.definition: Understanding and reasoning over very long documents or contexts.
examples: find contradictions in a long contract
agentic_examples: Read the large set of documents in /data/corpus, cross-check the claims in /data/claims.txt against them, and mark each claim as supported, contradicted or unverifiable with the supporting passage.
Go through the full transcript in /data/meeting.txt and the attached reports and answer the detailed questions in /data/questions.md.

task_types.name: Complex Instruction Following
task_types.definition: Adhering to complex, multi-part, or nuanced instructions with constraints.
examples: write a response that meets all specified criteria
agentic_examples: Follow all the rules in /root/policy.md while processing the requests in /root/requests.json: some rules override others, and every exception must be recorded in /root/decisions.json with the rule that applied.
Complete the task under the following constraints: do not modify files outside /app/out, keep the runtime under one minute, use only the allowed libraries, and document each assumption you make.

task_types.name: Visual Reasoning
task_types.definition: Reasoning about images, diagrams, or visual data combined with text.
agentic_examples: Inspect the images and charts in /root/figures, read the values off them, and use them to answer the questions in /root/questions.md.

task_types.name: Scientific Coding
task_types.definition: Writing code for scientific simulations, data analysis, or research tasks.
examples: write code to analyze experimental data
agentic_examples: Using the measurements in /data/observations.csv, fit the model described in /data/README.md, estimate the parameters with uncertainties, and save the fitted values to /output/params.json.

Simulate the system described in /app/model.md with a numerical integrator, compare against the reference trajectory in /data/ref.npy, and tune the step size so the error stays below the stated tolerance.
Write a Python script that processes the raw sensor files in /data/raw, applies the calibration from /data/calibration.json, and computes the physical quantities requested in /app/task.md.

task_types.name: Terminal Agent
task_types.definition: Using terminal or shell environments to perform agentic coding and system tasks.
agentic_examples: You are in a Linux sandbox with a broken build. Use the shell to find out why `make` fails, fix the problem in the source or the environment, and make sure `./run_tests.sh` passes.
Use the command line to inspect the files in /root, work out what has to be done from /root/TASK.md, carry it out with the tools available, and verify the result.
Compile the project in /workspace, run the benchmark binary, profile where the time goes, and apply changes until it runs at least twice as fast.

task_types.name: API Chaining
task_types.definition: Chaining multiple API calls or tool invocations in sequence to achieve a goal.
examples: fetch data from API A, transform it, and post to API B
agentic_examples: Use the provided HTTP API at http://localhost:8000 to look up the customer, fetch their orders, issue the refund for the failed one, and confirm the final state, writing each response to /root/trace.json.
Call the endpoints described in /root/openapi.yaml in the right order to create the resource, attach the files, and publish it, handling pagination and errors.

task_types.name: Competition Math
task_types.definition: Solving high-level mathematical competition problems (e.g., AIME, Olympiad).

task_types.name: Data Analysis Report
task_types.definition: Analyzing data and generating a structured report with insights and visualizations.
examples: analyze this dataset and write a summary
create a report on sales trends
agentic_examples: Analyze the dataset in /data/measurements.csv, compute the statistics requested in /data/README.md, and write your findings and the numbers to /output/report.md and /output/results.json.
Examine the network capture summary in /data/traffic.json, identify anomalous hosts or intrusion patterns, and write a short report with evidence to /output/findings.md.
Using the sales spreadsheet in /data/sales.xlsx, compute monthly trends and outliers, build the requested charts, and write the analysis to /output/analysis.md.

task_types.name: Knowledge QA
task_types.definition: Answering factual questions by retrieving knowledge from a corpus or memory.
examples: what is the capital of France?
agentic_examples: Using the reference documents in /data/docs, answer the questions in /data/questions.txt and write short, precise answers to /data/answers.txt.
Look up the requirements in the standards documents provided under /data/standards and state which ones apply to the system described in /data/system.md.

task_types.name: Sentiment Analysis
task_types.definition: Analyzing the sentiment, emotion, or tone of text.
examples: determine if this review is positive or negative

task_types.name: Content Moderation
task_types.definition: Identifying and moderating harmful, toxic, or policy-violating content.

task_types.name: Format Constraint
task_types.definition: Generating output that strictly adheres to a specified format (e.g., JSON, XML, markdown).
agentic_examples: Produce the result as a JSON file at /root/answer.json with exactly the keys and number formats given in the task, rounded to two decimals, because it is checked by an automatic script.
Write the output as a CSV with the header and column order specified in /root/format.md. A single wrong column name makes the whole answer fail.

task_types.name: Diagram Understanding
task_types.definition: Interpreting and reasoning about diagrams, flowcharts, or schematics.
examples: what does this circuit diagram represent?
agentic_examples: Look at the architecture diagram image at /root/diagram.png, list the components and the connections between them, and write them to /root/graph.json.

task_types.name: Code Review
task_types.definition: Reviewing code for quality, correctness, style, and potential improvements.
agentic_examples: Audit the source under /app/src for security vulnerabilities such as injection, unsafe deserialization and path traversal, and write each finding with file, line and severity to /app/report.json.
Review the patch in /app/change.diff for correctness and style problems and list the issues you find, ordered by importance.
Check the configuration files under /etc/service for insecure settings and produce a list of misconfigurations with recommended fixes.

task_types.name: Logical Puzzle
task_types.definition: Solving logic puzzles, riddles, or brain teasers requiring deductive reasoning.

task_types.name: Creative Writing
task_types.definition: Generating original creative text such as stories, poems, or dialogues.
